payload.name: Split PDF Without Uploading by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup browser PDF splitter for removing or separating pages.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based PDF splitter for separating pages, trimming document packets, pulling one form from a multi-page file, or preparing smaller upload-ready PDFs. It requires no account, keeps ordinary files local during use, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
